senses.why: The mind also weaves: a set of memories and feelings clusters around one theme and begins to act as a single force.
senses.whyCN: 心灵也在编织：一组记忆与情感围绕一个主题聚成团，开始像一股单一力量那样起作用。

senses.title: A chemical complex
senses.definition: in chemistry, a structure in which molecules or ions are bound together
senses.definitionCN: 化学中由分子或离子结合在一起形成的结构
senses.example: The enzyme forms a complex with the substrate.
senses.exampleCN: 这种酶与底物形成络合物。
senses.why: Chemistry gives the word a precise physical meaning: separate units are bound into one connected structure.
senses.whyCN: 化学给了这个词精确的物理含义：分开的单元被结合成一个相连的结构。

senses.title: A scientific system of many variables
senses.definition: in science, a system whose many interacting parts cannot be explained one by one
senses.definitionCN: 科学中指各部分相互作用、无法逐一解释的系统
senses.example: Climate is a complex system with many feedback loops.
senses.exampleCN: 气候是一个含有多条反馈回路的复杂系统。
senses.why: The emphasis is on interaction rather than size. A complex system behaves differently from the sum of its parts.
senses.whyCN: 重点在“相互作用”而不是规模。复杂系统的行为不等于各部分的简单相加。

senses.title: A whole of intertwined factors
senses.definition: a set of connected things or factors regarded as one whole
senses.definitionCN: 一组相互关联的事物或因素被视为一个整体
senses.example: The decision grew out of a complex of economic and social pressures.
senses.exampleCN: 这个决定源于经济与社会压力交织成的一团因素。
senses.why: The noun can name the knot itself rather than any single part: not a factor, but the whole tangle of factors.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词可以命名整个结，而不是其中某一根线：不是某个因素，而是因素交织成的一整团。

intro.en: Complex is a weaving word: Latin complecti 'to embrace, encircle'. The modern senses of difficulty, buildings, and psychology all keep the idea of parts woven into one.
intro.cn: complex 是一个“编织”词：拉丁语 complecti“拥抱、环绕”。现代的“困难”“建筑群”“心理情结”诸义，都保留着“部分被织成一体”的意象。

items.en: Complecti meant 'to encircle, embrace, comprehend'. It was built from com- 'together' plus plectere 'to weave, braid'.
items.cn: complecti 意为“环抱、拥抱、理解”，由 com-“一起”加 plectere“编织、编辫”构成。

items.en: Complexus, the past participle used as a noun, meant 'a surrounding, an embracing, a combination'. It pictured arms holding several things at once.
items.cn: complexus 是过去分词作名词，意为“环绕、拥抱、组合”，画面是双臂一次抱住好几样东西。

items.en: English adopted complex in the 17th century with the sense 'composed of parts, composite'. It belonged first to learned and scientific writing.
items.cn: 英语于 17 世纪借入 complex，意为“由多个部分组成的、复合的”，最初属于学术与科学写作。

items.en: The noun extended to groups of connected buildings and to chemical structures, where separate units are bound into one whole.
items.cn: 名词义扩展到相连的建筑群与化学结构：分开的单元被结合成一个整体。

items.en: Psychology gave complex its modern emotional sense: a cluster of linked feelings around one theme. Freud and Adler popularised the term.
items.cn: 心理学赋予 complex 现代情感义：围绕一个主题的一簇相连情感。弗洛伊德与阿德勒使这一术语流行。

items.en: The root plectere also gives plexus and perplex; complexion comes from complexio. Complex is not from plicare 'to fold', though the two roots are close in meaning and often confused.
items.cn: 词根 plectere 还给出 plexus 与 perplex；complexion 来自 complexio。complex 并非来自 plicare“折叠”，尽管两个词根意思接近、常被混淆。

note.en: The first group is chosen for spelling, the second for meaning, so that form and sense stay separate.
note.cn: 第一组按拼写挑选，第二组按词义挑选，这样词形和词义不会混在一起。

entries.definition: the state of having many interconnected parts. It is the noun built on complex.
entries.definitionCN: 复杂性。它是建立在 complex 上的名词。

entries.definition: the colour and texture of the skin, or the general character of something. It comes from Latin complexio, the same weaving root.
entries.definitionCN: 肤色；面色；事物的性质。来自拉丁 complexio，同一“编织”词根。

entries.definition: to confuse or puzzle. It uses the same plectere 'weave' root with per- 'thoroughly'.
entries.definitionCN: 使困惑；使费解。同一 plectere“编织”词根，加 per-“彻底”。

entries.definition: an instrument for finding direction. It shares the com- + pass- shape but comes from passus 'step'.
entries.definitionCN: 指南针；圆规。同为 com- + pass- 结构，但来自 passus“步”。

entries.definition: difficult because of many details. It stresses the difficulty of following the parts.
entries.definitionCN: 复杂的；难懂的。强调细节多、难以跟进。

entries.definition: having many small parts arranged in a precise way. It stresses delicate detail rather than difficulty.
entries.definitionCN: 错综复杂的；精细的。强调细节精致，而不是难度。

entries.definition: made by combining separate parts. It describes the construction, not the difficulty.
entries.definitionCN: 合成的；复合的。描述构成方式，而不是难度。

entries.definition: a set of connected people or things. It names the connections themselves.
entries.definitionCN: 网络；网状系统。命名的是连接本身。

normalIntro.en: These links are real: Latin plectere 'weave', the perplex/plexus family, and the fixed phrases complex system and inferiority complex.
normalIntro.cn: 这些联想都是真实的：拉丁语 plectere“编织”、perplex/plexus 词族，以及 complex system、inferiority complex 等固定搭配。

normal.en: complex = com- 'together' + plectere 'weave': parts are woven into one fabric.
normal.cn: complex = com-“一起”+ plectere“编织”：各部分被织进同一块布。

normal.en: perplex uses the same root: to be perplexed is to be tangled up in the threads.
normal.cn: perplex 用同一词根：困惑就是被线缠住了。

normal.en: A sports complex weaves separate buildings into one place by shared function.
normal.cn: 体育中心靠共同功能，把各自独立的建筑织成一个场所。

normal.en: An inferiority complex is a knot of feelings tied to one theme, not a single emotion.
normal.cn: 自卑情结是系在一个主题上的一团情感，而不是单一情绪。

normal.en: A complex sentence nests clauses inside clauses, like threads inside threads.
normal.cn: 复合句把从句嵌进从句，就像线里套线。

abstract.en: The core picture is a knot: many threads cross, and pulling one moves the whole shape.
abstract.cn: 核心画面是一个结：许多线交叉，拉动其中一根，整个形状都会变。

abstract.en: Complexity is about interaction, not quantity: a thousand separate stones are not complex, but ten tied threads are.
abstract.cn: 复杂关乎相互作用，而不是数量：一千块分开的石头并不复杂，十根系在一起的线才复杂。

abstract.en: The same knot can be a difficulty, a building, a feeling, or a molecule, depending on what is woven.
abstract.cn: 同一个结可以是困难、建筑、情感或分子，取决于被织进去的是什么。

examples.en: The problem is more complex than the report suggests.
examples.cn: 问题比报告所呈现的更复杂。

examples.en: They built a new apartment complex beside the station.
examples.cn: 他们在车站旁建了一个新的公寓小区。

examples.en: The novel explores his complex relationship with his father.
examples.cn: 这部小说探讨了他与父亲之间复杂的关系。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「康普莱克斯」——康普把一堆线莱克斯（捋）在一起，越理越乱 → complex 复杂的

root: 源自拉丁语 complexus“环抱、组合”，出自 complecti（com-“一起”+ plectere“编织”），核心是“多个部分交织成一个整体”，故引申为“复杂”。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses of complex, one knot in different materials: connected parts, mental difficulty, numbers, sentences, buildings, feelings, molecules, systems, and a tangle of factors.
sensesIntro.cn: complex 的九个义项是同一个结在不同材料上的样子：相连的部分、头脑的困难、数、句子、建筑、情感、分子、系统，以及一团交织的因素。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: many threads woven into one knot, where each thread affects the others.
core.cn: 核心意象：许多线被织成一个结，每根线都影响其他线。

branches.en: THE TANGLE: connected parts, the difficulty of holding them all, and systems where interaction defeats simple addition.
branches.cn: 缠结：相连的部分、无法同时握住的困难，以及相互作用使简单相加失效的系统。

branches.en: FORMAL WEAVING: a complex number joins real and imaginary parts, and a complex sentence nests clauses.
branches.cn: 形式化的编织：复数把实部与虚部结合，复合句把从句嵌套。

branches.en: BUILT AND BOUND WHOLES: buildings become one complex by shared use, molecules become one complex by chemical binding.
branches.cn: 建成与结合的整块：建筑因共同使用成为园区，分子因化学键合成为络合物。

branches.en: A KNOT IN THE MIND: a psychological complex is a cluster of linked feelings around one theme.
branches.cn: 心里的结：心理情结是围绕一个主题的一簇相连情感。

branches.en: THE WHOLE TANGLE ITSELF: a complex of factors is named as one object, not as separate causes.
branches.cn: 整团交织本身：a complex of factors 把一团因素命名为一个对象，而不是分开的原因。

intro.en: Complex is Latin complexus, the past participle of complecti. Its -plex is not a productive English suffix here, but it links the word to plexus and perplex; English builds -ity and -ly on complex.
intro.cn: complex 是拉丁语 complexus，即 complecti 的过去分词。这里的 -plex 不是英语中能产的后缀，但它把该词与 plexus、perplex 联系起来；英语在 complex 上构成 -ity 与 -ly。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root plectere 'to weave, braid' gives complecti, complexus, plexus and perplexus. English also inherited complexion through complexio.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 plectere“编织、编辫”给出 complecti、complexus、plexus、perplexus。英语还经由 complexio 继承了 complexion。

items.meaning: woven together; a connected whole
items.meaningCN: 复杂的；综合体（com- 表“一起”，plectere 表“编织”）
items.example: The building is a large complex.
items.exampleCN: 这栋建筑是一个大型综合体。

items.meaning: the state of having many interconnected parts
items.meaningCN: 复杂性（-ity 构成性质名词）
items.example: The complexity of the tax code is notorious.
items.exampleCN: 这套税法的复杂性是出了名的。

items.meaning: in a complex way
items.meaningCN: 复杂地（-ly 构成副词）
items.example: The plot is complexly structured.
items.exampleCN: 情节结构十分复杂。

items.meaning: to make something complex
items.meaningCN: 使复杂化（-ify 表“使成为”，技术用语）
items.example: Each new rule complexifies the process.
items.exampleCN: 每一条新规则都让流程更复杂。

items.meaning: skin colour; the general character of something
items.meaningCN: 肤色；事物的性质（同出复杂词根）
items.example: The news changed the complexion of the race.
items.exampleCN: 这条消息改变了这场竞选的局面。

items.meaning: to tangle, confuse
items.meaningCN: 使困惑；使费解（per-“彻底”+ plectere“编织”）
items.example: The instructions perplexed everyone.
items.exampleCN: 这些说明把所有人都弄糊涂了。

items.meaning: a network of nerves or vessels
items.meaningCN: （神经或血管的）丛（同一编织词根）
items.example: The brachial plexus supplies the arm.
items.exampleCN: 臂丛神经支配手臂。

items.meaning: to make more difficult by adding parts
items.meaningCN: 使复杂化（来自 plicare“折叠”，与 plectere 相近但不同）
items.example: Bad weather complicated the rescue.
items.exampleCN: 恶劣天气使救援更加困难。

definition_zh: 组成部分；部件；成分；元件；分向量
definition_en: one of the parts that together make a whole machine, system, or mixture
core_image: 一台机器被拆成若干个零件，摆在同一张桌上
scene: 工作台上，坏掉的电机被拆开，零件放在托盘里。 The engineer took the broken motor apart and checked every component one by one.
sceneCN: 这里 component 是「部件」（第 1 个义项：构成机器的单个零件）；句意：工程师把坏掉的电机拆开，逐个检查每个部件。

pos.zh: 组成部分；部件；成分；元件

derivatives.zh: 使组件化；拆分为组件（技术用语）

senses.title: A physical part of a machine
senses.definition: one of the parts from which a machine or device is built
senses.definitionCN: 构成机器或装置的零件之一
senses.example: The pump has only three moving components.
senses.exampleCN: 这台泵只有三个运动部件。
senses.why: The Latin verb means 'to put together'. A component is one of the things that were put together to make the object.
senses.whyCN: 这个拉丁动词意为“放在一起”。component 就是被放在一起、从而造出该物的其中一件。

senses.title: An element of a system
senses.definition: one of the parts of a system, especially in software or engineering
senses.definitionCN: 系统的一部分，尤用于软件或工程
senses.example: The database is a core component of the service.
senses.exampleCN: 数据库是这个服务的核心组件。
senses.why: Software is assembled from modules the way a machine is assembled from parts. The word moves from metal to code without changing.
senses.whyCN: 软件由模块组装，正如机器由零件组装。这个词从金属转到代码，意思没有改变。

senses.title: An ingredient in a mixture
senses.definition: one of the substances that make up a mixture or material
senses.definitionCN: 构成混合物或材料的物质之一
senses.example: Water is a key component of the ink.
senses.exampleCN: 水是这种墨水的重要成分。
senses.why: Here the 'put together' is literal mixing. Each substance contributes something that the whole would lack.
senses.whyCN: 这里的“放在一起”就是字面混合。每种物质都贡献了整体缺少就不可的东西。

senses.title: A vector component
senses.definition: in mathematics and physics, one of the parts into which a vector can be resolved
senses.definitionCN: 数学与物理中，一个向量可被分解出的部分
senses.example: The vertical component of the force is small.
senses.exampleCN: 这个力的竖直分量很小。
senses.why: Mathematics splits a whole into directions. Each component is a part that can be added back to rebuild the original vector.
senses.whyCN: 数学把一个整体按方向拆开。每个分量都是可以加回去、重建原向量的部分。

senses.title: An electronic component
senses.definition: a small physical device such as a resistor or chip used in circuits
senses.definitionCN: 电路中使用的电阻、芯片等小型器件
senses.example: The board contains hundreds of tiny components.
senses.exampleCN: 这块板上有数百个微小元件。
senses.why: Electronics made the word concrete and countable: components are the standardised pieces a circuit is built from.
senses.whyCN: 电子学让这个词变得具体、可计数：元件就是构成电路的标准件。

senses.title: Component parts
senses.definition: used before a noun, meaning forming one of the parts of a larger whole
senses.definitionCN: 放在名词前，表示“构成更大整体之一的”
senses.example: The component parts were shipped separately.
senses.exampleCN: 各组成部件是分开运输的。
senses.why: The noun turns into an adjective without changing its relation: it still names a part that belongs to a whole.
senses.whyCN: 名词转为形容词，关系没变：它仍然指属于某个整体的部分。

senses.title: A blood component
senses.definition: in medicine, one separable part of blood such as plasma or platelets
senses.definitionCN: 医学中血液里可分离的部分，如血浆或血小板
senses.example: The patient received only the plasma component.
senses.exampleCN: 病人只接受了血浆成分。
senses.why: Medicine separates a complex fluid into parts that can be given individually. Each part is still a component of the whole.
senses.whyCN: 医学把一种复杂流体分成可以单独输注的部分。每一部分仍是整体的 component。

senses.title: An element of a plan or argument
senses.definition: one of the parts that make up a plan, argument, or strategy
senses.definitionCN: 构成计划、论证或策略的部分之一
senses.example: Training is one component of the reform, not the whole of it.
senses.exampleCN: 培训只是改革的一个组成部分，而不是全部。
senses.why: Abstract wholes are assembled too: an argument has parts that support it, and a plan has parts that must all work.
senses.whyCN: 抽象的整体也是被组装起来的：论证有支撑它的部分，计划有必须全部奏效的部分。

intro.en: Component is the present participle of Latin componere 'to put together'. The same verb gives compound and compose, so the three words are a family, not accidental look-alikes.
intro.cn: component 是拉丁语 componere“放在一起”的现在分词。同一个动词还给出 compound 与 compose，所以这三个词是同一词族，而不是偶然形近。

items.en: Componere meant 'to put together, join, arrange'. It was built from com- 'together' plus ponere 'to place, put'.
items.cn: componere 意为“放在一起、连接、安排”，由 com-“一起”加 ponere“放置”构成。

items.en: Componens, the present participle, meant 'putting together; forming a part'. English took the participle form directly as component.
items.cn: 现在分词 componens 意为“正在放在一起的；构成一部分的”。英语直接把这一分词形式借为 component。

items.en: Component entered English in the 17th century as an adjective meaning 'constituting a compound', then as a noun for the part itself.
items.cn: component 于 17 世纪进入英语，先作形容词“构成复合物的”，后作名词指部分本身。

items.en: Engineering and electronics made the noun ordinary and countable: machine components, electrical components, component parts.
items.cn: 工程与电子学使这个名词变得日常而可数：机器部件、电气元件、组成部件。

items.en: Modern use extends to software modules, blood products, vectors, and elements of plans. The unchanged idea is a part that belongs to an assembled whole.
items.cn: 现代用法扩及软件模块、血液制品、向量与计划要素。不变的意思是“属于某个组装整体的部分”。

items.en: Component, compound and compose all descend from componere. Compound is the result or the act, compose is the act of arranging, and component is one item in the arrangement.
items.cn: component、compound、compose 都出自 componere。compound 指结果或动作，compose 指编排动作，component 指编排中的一项。

note.en: The first group is chosen for spelling, the second for meaning, so that form and sense stay separate.
note.cn: 第一组按拼写挑选，第二组按词义挑选，这样词形和词义不会混在一起。

entries.definition: a thing made of parts, or to put parts together. It comes from the same Latin verb componere.
entries.definitionCN: 化合物；复合物；使混合。它来自同一个拉丁动词 componere。

entries.definition: to put together or create. It is the verb from componere, and component is one of its parts.
entries.definitionCN: 组成；创作。它是来自 componere 的动词，component 则是其组成中的一项。

entries.definition: a rival in a contest. It uses the same ponere root but with ob- 'against'.
entries.definitionCN: 对手。同一 ponere 词根，但前缀是 ob-“反对”。

entries.definition: the components of a system taken as a group. It is built on component.
entries.definitionCN: 部件总成；元件集合。它由 component 构成。

entries.definition: a piece of a whole. It is the plain everyday word, with no technical flavour.
entries.definitionCN: 部分；零件。最日常的词，不带技术色彩。

entries.definition: a basic part of a whole, often abstract. It is common for ideas and systems.
entries.definitionCN: 要素；元素。常指抽象整体中的基本部分。

entries.definition: one of the substances mixed to make something, especially food. It is the kitchen word for a component.
entries.definitionCN: 成分；原料。尤指食物，是 component 在厨房里的说法。

entries.definition: a self-contained unit that can be combined with others. It stresses replaceability.
entries.definitionCN: 模块。强调可替换、可组合的独立单元。

normalIntro.en: These links are real: Latin ponere 'place', the compose/compound family, and the fixed phrases component part and electronic component.
normalIntro.cn: 这些联想都是真实的：拉丁语 ponere“放置”、compose/compound 词族，以及 component part、electronic component 等固定搭配。

normal.en: component = com- 'together' + ponere 'place': one of the things placed together.
normal.cn: component = com-“一起”+ ponere“放置”：被放在一起的其中一件。

normal.en: Component, compound and compose are one family: the part, the result, and the act of putting together.
normal.cn: component、compound、compose 是一家：部分、结果，以及“放在一起”的动作。

normal.en: Opponent uses the same ponere but with 'against': one placed opposite you, not beside you.
normal.cn: opponent 用同一 ponere，但加“反对”：被放在你对面，而不是你身边。

normal.en: An electronic component is countable and replaceable: the circuit is a set of standard pieces.
normal.cn: 电子元件可数、可替换：电路就是一组标准件。

normal.en: A component of a plan is still a part: the plan fails if that part is missing.
normal.cn: 计划的 component 仍是部分：缺了它，计划就不成立。

abstract.en: The core picture is a table of disassembled parts: the whole is not on the table, only what can be put back.
abstract.cn: 核心画面是一桌拆开的零件：桌上没有整体，只有可以装回去的东西。

abstract.en: A component has no meaning alone: it is defined by the whole it belongs to and the place it occupies.
abstract.cn: component 单独没有意义：它的意义由所属的整体和所占的位置决定。

abstract.en: The same part can be a component of a machine, a system, a mixture, or an argument; only the whole changes.
abstract.cn: 同一部件可以是机器、系统、混合物或论证的 component；变的只是整体。

examples.en: The factory makes components for aircraft engines.
examples.cn: 这家工厂为飞机发动机生产部件。

examples.en: Trust is a vital component of any team.
examples.cn: 信任是任何团队的关键要素。

examples.en: The software is built from reusable components.
examples.cn: 这个软件由可复用的组件构建而成。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「肯破能」——肯破开机器，才能看出里面每个能用的件 → component 部件、成分

root: 源自拉丁语 componere“放在一起”的现在分词 componens，由 com-“一起”+ ponere“放置”构成，核心是“被放在一起、构成整体的一个部分”，与 compound、compose 同源。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of component, all one part of an assembled whole: a machine part, a system module, an ingredient, a vector component, an electronic part, an attributive 'component part', a blood product, and an element of a plan.
sensesIntro.cn: component 的八个义项都是“组装整体中的一个部分”：机器零件、系统模块、混合成分、向量分量、电子元件、定语用法“组成部件”、血液制品，以及计划中的一个要素。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a table covered with the disassembled parts of one machine.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张桌子，摆满同一台机器拆下来的零件。

branches.en: HARDWARE: a machine is a set of moving parts, and a circuit is a set of standard electronic parts.
branches.cn: 硬件：机器是一组运动部件，电路是一组标准电子元件。

branches.en: SYSTEMS AND PLANS: software modules and the parts of an argument are assembled the same way.
branches.cn: 系统与计划：软件模块与论证组成部分，按同样方式组装。

branches.en: SUBSTANCES: an ingredient in ink and a fraction of blood are both separable parts of a mixture.
branches.cn: 物质：墨水成分与血液成分，都是混合物中可分离的部分。

branches.en: DIRECTIONS: a vector splits into components that can be added back.
branches.cn: 方向：向量可拆成分量，分量又能加回去。

branches.en: ATTRIBUTIVE USE: 'component parts' keeps the part-to-whole relation in adjective position.
branches.cn: 定语用法：component parts 在形容词位置仍保留“部分对整体”的关系。

intro.en: Component is a Latin present participle, so its -ent is a participle ending rather than an English suffix. English builds componential, componentry and the technical componentize on it.
intro.cn: component 是拉丁语现在分词，所以 -ent 是分词词尾，不是英语后缀。英语在其上构成 componential、componentry 以及技术用语 componentize。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root ponere 'to place' is highly productive: component, compound, compose, composition, deposit, position and postpone all descend from it through different prefixes.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 ponere“放置”能产性很高：component、compound、compose、composition、deposit、position、postpone 都经由不同前缀出自它。

items.meaning: a part placed together with others
items.meaningCN: 组成部分；部件（com- 表“一起”，ponere 表“放置”）
items.example: Each component is tested separately.
items.exampleCN: 每个部件都单独测试。

items.meaning: relating to components
items.meaningCN: 成分的；组件的（-ial 构成形容词）
items.example: The theory has a componential analysis.
items.exampleCN: 这一理论有一种成分分析法。

items.meaning: the components of a system as a group
items.meaningCN: 部件总成；元件集合（-ry 表示集合）
items.example: The componentry is all off-the-shelf.
items.exampleCN: 所有元件都是现成的。

items.meaning: to break something into components
items.meaningCN: 使组件化；拆分为组件（-ize 表“使成为”）
items.example: They componentized the old system.
items.exampleCN: 他们把旧系统组件化了。

items.meaning: a thing put together; to put together
items.meaningCN: 化合物；复合物；使混合（同一词根，分词形式）
items.example: The two elements form a compound.
items.exampleCN: 这两种元素形成一种化合物。

items.meaning: to put together, arrange, create
items.meaningCN: 组成；创作（同一词根的动词形式）
items.example: She composed the piece in one evening.
items.exampleCN: 她用一个晚上创作了这首曲子。

items.meaning: the act of putting together; the resulting whole
items.meaningCN: 构成；作品（-ition 构成动作名词）
items.example: The composition of the soil affects growth.
items.exampleCN: 土壤的构成影响植物生长。

items.meaning: to place down; something placed down
items.meaningCN: 存放；沉积；押金（de-“向下”+ ponere“放置”）
items.example: They deposited the money at the bank.
items.exampleCN: 他们把钱存进了银行。

items.meaning: to place after; to delay
items.meaningCN: 推迟（post-“在后”+ ponere“放置”）
items.example: They postponed the meeting until Friday.
items.exampleCN: 他们把会议推迟到周五。

latinEntries.meaningCN: 正在组合的；构成部分的

definition_zh: 化合物；复合物；复合词；围起来的场地；复合的；使加剧；混合
definition_en: something made of two or more parts, or to make something worse by adding to it
core_image: 几样原料被倒进同一口锅，熬成一种新东西
scene: 化学课上，学生把两种溶液倒进烧杯。 In the chemistry class the students poured two solutions into a beaker and a new compound formed.
sceneCN: 这里 compound 是「化合物」（第 2 个义项：由两种或更多元素化合而成的新物质）；句意：化学课上，学生把两种溶液倒进烧杯，生成了一种新的化合物。

pos.zh: 化合物；复合物；复合词；围起来的场地

forms.label: 过去分词（动词，完成／被动）

derivatives.zh: 复合；复利计算；调配（药学）

senses.title: A thing made of parts
senses.titleCN: 由多个部分组成的复合物
senses.definition: a thing formed by combining two or more separate parts or elements
senses.definitionCN: 由两个或更多独立部分或元素结合而成的事物
senses.example: The sculpture is a compound of wood and steel.
senses.exampleCN: 这座雕塑是木材与钢材的复合体。
senses.why: The Latin verb means 'to put together'. A compound is the result of that act: separate ingredients now presented as one object.
senses.whyCN: 这个拉丁动词意为“放在一起”。compound 就是那个动作的结果：分开的成分现在作为一个物体呈现。

senses.title: A chemical compound
senses.definition: a substance formed when two or more elements combine chemically
senses.definitionCN: 两种或更多元素经化学结合形成的物质
senses.example: Water is a compound of hydrogen and oxygen.
senses.exampleCN: 水是氢与氧的化合物。
senses.why: Chemistry gives the strongest version: the parts are not mixed loosely but bonded, so the new substance has properties neither part had.
senses.whyCN: 化学给出了最强的版本：各成分不是松散混合，而是键合，新物质的性质两个成分都没有。

senses.title: A compound word
senses.definition: in language, a word made by joining two or more words
senses.definitionCN: 语言学中由两个或更多词结合而成的词
senses.example: Sunflower is a compound made from sun and flower.
senses.exampleCN: sunflower 是由 sun 与 flower 构成的复合词。
senses.why: Language also puts words together. The compound word has a meaning that can be more than the two parts, which is why it counts as one word.
senses.whyCN: 语言也会把词放在一起。复合词的意义可能超出两个部分之和，所以它算作一个词。

senses.title: An enclosed yard or premises
senses.definition: an area enclosed by a fence or wall, often with buildings inside
senses.definitionCN: 由篱笆或墙围起来的区域，里面常有建筑
senses.example: The embassy compound has its own garden.
senses.exampleCN: 大使馆的院区有自己的花园。
senses.why: This sense has a different origin: it comes from Malay kampung 'village, enclosure', not from the Latin 'put together'. The two words share spelling only.
senses.whyCN: 这一义来源完全不同：来自马来语 kampung“村庄、围地”，而非拉丁语“放在一起”。两个词只是拼写相同。

senses.title: A compound fracture
senses.definition: in medicine, a break in which the bone pierces the skin
senses.definitionCN: 医学中指骨头穿破皮肤的骨折
senses.example: The compound fracture required immediate surgery.
senses.exampleCN: 开放性骨折需要立即手术。
senses.why: The adjective means 'composite' in a grim sense: the injury combines a broken bone with an open wound, making it more serious than a simple break.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词在这里是“复合”的严峻用法：伤势把骨折与开放伤口合成一体，因此比单纯骨折更严重。

senses.title: Compound interest
senses.definition: interest calculated on both the original sum and the interest already added
senses.definitionCN: 既按本金又按已加入的利息计算的利息
senses.example: Compound interest makes small savings grow quickly.
senses.exampleCN: 复利让小笔储蓄增长得很快。
senses.why: Finance compounds by adding interest to the base and then charging interest on the larger base. The 'put together' is repeated growth.
senses.whyCN: 金融的“复合”是把利息加进本金，再按更大的本金计息。这里的“放在一起”是反复叠加的增长。

senses.title: To make a problem worse
senses.definition: to make a bad situation worse by adding another difficulty
senses.definitionCN: 通过增加新的困难使糟糕局面更糟
senses.example: The delay compounded the damage to their reputation.
senses.exampleCN: 这次延误使他们声誉受到的损害雪上加霜。
senses.why: The verb adds one bad thing to another, so the two now act together. A compound problem is one whose parts multiply its force.
senses.whyCN: 动词把一件坏事加到另一件上，两者从此共同作用。复合的问题，就是各部分会互相放大力量的问题。

senses.title: To mix ingredients
senses.definition: to mix substances, especially in pharmacy or cooking
senses.definitionCN: 混合物质，尤用于配药或烹饪
senses.example: The pharmacist compounded the cream by hand.
senses.exampleCN: 药剂师手工调配了这种药膏。
senses.why: The oldest physical sense: take separate substances and make one preparation out of them.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的物理义：把分开的物质取来，配成一种制剂。

senses.title: To settle a debt by agreement
senses.titleCN: 和解；部分偿还以了结债务
senses.definition: to settle a debt or claim by agreeing to pay part of it
senses.definitionCN: 通过同意支付部分款项来结清债务或索赔
senses.example: The debtor compounded with his creditors for half the sum.
senses.exampleCN: 债务人与其债权人达成和解，按半数额清偿。
senses.why: Here the 'putting together' is an agreement: both sides combine their claims into one settlement. The sense survives mainly in legal English.
senses.whyCN: 这里的“放在一起”是一份协议：双方把各自的主张合成一个了结方案。这一义主要保存在法律英语中。

intro.en: Compound has two unrelated origins. The part-and-whole word comes from Latin componere; the 'enclosed yard' word comes from Malay kampung. They are homographs, not relatives.
intro.cn: compound 有两个互不相关的来源。“部分与整体”这一支来自拉丁语 componere；“围起来的场地”这一支来自马来语 kampung。它们是同形异源词，不是亲戚。

items.en: Componere meant 'to put together, join, arrange'. It was built from com- 'together' plus ponere 'to place, put'.
items.cn: componere 意为“放在一起、连接、安排”，由 com-“一起”加 ponere“放置”构成。

items.en: Old French compondre carried the word into English in the 14th century. The noun first meant a combination, the verb 'to combine or mix'.
items.cn: 古法语 compondre 于 14 世纪把这个词带入英语。名词先指“组合物”，动词指“合并、混合”。

items.en: Chemistry gave compound its precise modern sense of a substance made by chemical combination. Compound interest is also a 17th-century financial term.
items.cn: 化学赋予 compound 现代精确义“经化学结合形成的物质”。复利也是 17 世纪的金融术语。

items.en: The 'enclosed yard' sense came separately, from Malay kampung 'village, enclosure', through Portuguese trading contacts.
items.cn: “围起来的场地”这一义另行而来，来自马来语 kampung“村庄、围地”，经葡萄牙人的贸易接触传入。

items.en: Modern English keeps both: a chemical compound, a compound word, a compound fracture, an embassy compound, and the verb 'to compound a problem'.
items.cn: 现代英语两支都保留：化合物、复合词、开放性骨折、使馆院区，以及动词“使问题加剧”。

items.en: Compound, component and compose all come from componere. Compound is the assembled result (or the act of assembling), component is one piece of the assembly, compose is the arranging.
items.cn: compound、component、compose 都出自 componere。compound 是组装的结果（或组装动作），component 是组装中的一件，compose 是编排。

note.en: The first group is chosen for spelling, the second for meaning, so that form and sense stay separate.
note.cn: 第一组按拼写挑选，第二组按词义挑选，这样词形和词义不会混在一起。

entries.definition: one part of an assembled whole. It comes from the same Latin verb componere.
entries.definitionCN: 组成部分；部件。它来自同一个拉丁动词 componere。

entries.definition: to put together or create. It is the verb behind compound and component.
entries.definitionCN: 组成；创作。它是 compound 与 component 背后的动词。

entries.definition: decayed organic material used as fertiliser. It shares the com- + post shape but comes from a different compound.
entries.definitionCN: 堆肥。同为 com- + post 结构，但来自另一个复合词。

entries.definition: the act of combining, or the calculation of compound interest. It is built on compound.
entries.definitionCN: 复合；复利计算；调配。它由 compound 构成。

entries.definition: a combination of substances that are not chemically bonded. It is looser than a chemical compound.
entries.definitionCN: 混合物。比化合物松散，成分间没有化学键合。

entries.definition: made by combining separate parts. It describes construction, not chemistry or grammar.
entries.definitionCN: 合成的；复合的。描述构造方式，不涉及化学或语法。

entries.definition: the result of joining things. It is the general word for what compound names more specifically.
entries.definitionCN: 组合；结合。它是 compound 更具体所指的泛称。

entries.definition: to make or become worse. It matches the verb sense without the idea of adding a second cause.
entries.definitionCN: 使恶化。对应动词义，但不含“再添一个原因”的意思。

normalIntro.en: These links are real: Latin componere 'put together', the component/compose family, and the fixed phrases compound interest and compound fracture.
normalIntro.cn: 这些联想都是真实的：拉丁语 componere“放在一起”、component/compose 词族，以及 compound interest、compound fracture 等固定搭配。

normal.en: compound = com- 'together' + ponere 'place': parts are placed together into one thing.
normal.cn: compound = com-“一起”+ ponere“放置”：各部分被放到一起成为一物。

normal.en: component is one piece of the compound; compose is the act of putting the pieces together.
normal.cn: component 是 compound 中的一件；compose 是把这些件放好的动作。

normal.en: Compound interest adds interest to the base, then charges interest on the larger base: growth placed on growth.
normal.cn: 复利把利息加进本金，再按更大的本金计息：增长叠加在增长上。

normal.en: A compound fracture combines two injuries, which is why it is more serious than a simple break.
normal.cn: 开放性骨折把两种伤合成一起，所以比单纯骨折更严重。

normal.en: An embassy compound is a different word: it comes from Malay kampung, meaning an enclosed village.
normal.cn: 使馆 compound 是另一个词：来自马来语 kampung，意为“围起来的村落”。

abstract.en: The core picture is a pot: separate ingredients go in, and one new thing comes out.
abstract.cn: 核心画面是一口锅：分开的原料放进去，出来的是一样新东西。

abstract.en: The result is more than a list: the parts act together, which is why a compound problem gets worse.
abstract.cn: 结果不只是一张清单：各部分共同作用，所以复合问题会越来越糟。

abstract.en: Same spelling, two histories: the chemical compound and the walled compound are strangers that happen to look alike.
abstract.cn: 同一拼写，两段历史：化合物与围起来的院区是碰巧长得像的陌生人。

examples.en: Salt is a compound of sodium and chlorine.
examples.cn: 盐是钠与氯的化合物。

examples.en: The bank pays compound interest on the account.
examples.cn: 银行对这个账户支付复利。

examples.en: Bad timing compounded the confusion.
examples.cn: 时机不当让混乱更加严重。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「康 pound」——康把几样东西按磅称好倒进一锅，合成一样新东西 → compound 化合物、复合物

root: 源自拉丁语 componere“放在一起”，由 com-“一起”+ ponere“放置”构成，与 component、compose 同源；“围起来的场地”一义则另来自马来语 kampung，属同形异源。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses of compound, mostly one act of putting together: a composite object, a chemical substance, a word, a fracture, repeated interest, an aggravated problem, a mixture, and a legal settlement. The walled yard is a separate word from Malay.
sensesIntro.cn: compound 的九个义项大多围绕同一个“放在一起”的动作：复合物、化合物、复合词、骨折、复利、加剧的问题、调配、法律和解。围起来的院区则是来自马来语的另一个词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: separate ingredients poured into one pot and coming out as a single new substance.
core.cn: 核心意象：分开的原料倒进同一口锅，出来时成为一样新物质。

branches.en: MATTER COMBINED: a sculpture of wood and steel, and a chemical substance whose parts are bonded.
branches.cn: 物质相合：木与钢的雕塑，以及成分键合的化学物质。

branches.en: WORDS COMBINED: sunflower joins two words into one new lexical unit.
branches.cn: 词相合：sunflower 把两个词并成一个新的词汇单位。

branches.en: TWO THINGS AT ONCE: a fracture with a wound, and interest charged on interest.
branches.cn: 两事叠加：带伤口的骨折，以及按利息计息的复利。

branches.en: THE VERB OF ADDING: mix ingredients, add one problem to another, or combine claims into a settlement.
branches.cn: “添加”的动词：调配原料、把一个问题加到另一个上，或把各方主张合成一个了结。

branches.en: A DIFFERENT WORD: the walled compound comes from Malay kampung, not from Latin componere.
branches.cn: 另一个词：围起来的院区来自马来语 kampung，而不是拉丁语 componere。

intro.en: Compound's -ound is not an English suffix; the word is the past participle of Latin componere. English adds -ing, -ed, -er and -able, and the spelling is identical for noun, adjective and verb.
intro.cn: compound 的 -ound 不是英语后缀；它是拉丁语 componere 的过去分词。英语加 -ing、-ed、-er、-able，且名词、形容词、动词拼写相同。

latinIntro.en: Componere is the source of compound, component, compose, composition and composite. The root ponere 'to place' also gives deposit, position and postpone.
latinIntro.cn: componere 是 compound、component、compose、composition、composite 的来源。词根 ponere“放置”还给出 deposit、position、postpone。

items.meaning: a thing put together; to put together
items.meaningCN: 化合物；复合物；使混合（com- 表“一起”，ponere 表“放置”）
items.example: The medicine is a compound of three herbs.
items.exampleCN: 这种药是三种草药的复合物。

items.meaning: the act of combining; calculating compound interest
items.meaningCN: 复合；复利计算；调配（-ing 构成名词或分词）
items.example: Compounding is done monthly.
items.exampleCN: 复利每月计算一次。

items.meaning: made worse, or mixed together
items.meaningCN: 加剧的；混合而成的（-ed 构成过去分词）
items.example: The error compounded the loss.
items.exampleCN: 这个错误加重了损失。

items.meaning: one who compounds, especially a pharmacist
items.meaningCN: 调配者；复合者（-er 表示人）
items.example: The compounder mixed the ointment.
items.exampleCN: 调配师混合了药膏。

items.meaning: able to be settled or combined
items.meaningCN: 可和解的；可复合的（-able 表“能够被……”）
items.example: The claim is compoundable out of court.
items.exampleCN: 这项索赔可以在庭外和解。

items.meaning: one part of an assembled whole
items.meaningCN: 组成部分；部件（同一词根的分词形式）
items.example: Each component fits into the frame.
items.exampleCN: 每个部件都能装进框架。

items.meaning: to put together, arrange, create
items.meaningCN: 组成；创作（同一词根的动词形式）
items.example: He composed the letter carefully.
items.exampleCN: 他仔细地写成了这封信。

items.meaning: a putting together; the resulting whole
items.meaningCN: 构成；作品（-ition 构成名词）
items.example: The composition of the committee changed.
items.exampleCN: 委员会的构成发生了变化。

items.meaning: made by combining parts
items.meaningCN: 合成的；复合的（同一过去分词 + 形容词后缀）
items.example: The wing is made of composite material.
items.exampleCN: 机翼由复合材料制成。

items.meaning: to place down; something placed down
items.meaningCN: 存放；沉积；押金（de-“向下”+ ponere“放置”）
items.example: She deposited the cheque at noon.
items.exampleCN: 她中午存入了支票。
